Rare opening — Villa Luisa, April 22 to May 3.

One of the last available windows before the summer season locks in. Villa Luisa is a 3-bedroom beachfront sanctuary on Patzcuaro Beach: a private infinity pool, a dedicated chef, outdoor kitchen and fire pit, and direct access to the Pacific from your terrace.

From here, the region opens up — surf breaks at Sayulita and Punta de Mita, whale watching from La Cruz marina, snorkeling at Islas Marietas, deep-sea fishing, yoga in the village, rooftop dining ten minutes away.

This stretch doesn't stay empty for long.
